response.sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS avg_unfilled FROM orderexecutions WHERE remaincount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ordersmark), overall AS (SELECT AVG(remaincount) AS benchmark1 FROM orderexecutions WHERE remaincount IS NOT NULL), first_stage AS (SELECT p.ordersmark, p.avg_unfilled, p.avg_unfilled - o.benchmark1 AS excess1 FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_unfilled > o.benchmark1), second_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_unfilled) AS benchmark2 FROM first_stage), final_stage AS (SELECT f.avg_unfilled, f.excess1, f.avg_unfilled - b.benchmark2 AS excess2 FROM first_stage f CROSS JOIN second_benchmark b WHERE f.avg_unfilled > b.benchmark2) SELECT AVG(avg_unfilled) AS avg_remaining_orders, AVG(excess1) AS avg_excess_over_first_benchmark, AVG(excess2) AS avg_excess_over_second_benchmark FROM final_stage;

assumptions.assumption: The request's benchmark and group averages ignore NULL remaincount values; orders whose executions all have NULL remaincount are excluded. GROUP BY treats NULL ordersmark values as one unreferenced order.
